描述_ZN: Scroll of Two Horses, modern, painted by Xu Beihong, on paper with color, 62 cm in length and 45.8 cm in width.　　Self-titled: "A complimentary gift from Ms. Tianqiong, a brother of Bide. Congratulation written by Beihong in the spring of 2004." Inscribed with a long rectangular seal in white characters, "Wang Sun of the East China Sea".　　Thirty-four years refers to the thirty-fourth year of the Republic of China (1945), when Xu Beihong was 50 years old.　　This painting is a wedding gift from Xu Beihong to Bide and Tianqiong, depicting the intimate scene of two horses driving side by side, clinging to each other in the running.　　In his later years, Xu Beihong's technique of painting horses has reached the stage of perfection. The outline of the horses in the picture is shaped by lines, and the lines are accurately outlined, fine and strong, and spontaneous, showing the author's profound line drawing skills. The various parts of the horse's body are colored with thick and light ink, showing its sense of volume, texture and light and dark relationships in layers of shades of ink.
